name: Host IT Smart
tagline: Budget Indian cPanel hosting with monthly billing and 24/7 support
description: Host IT Smart is a budget Indian web host offering cPanel shared, reseller and KVM VPS hosting with NVMe SSD storage and flexible monthly billing.
about: Host IT Smart is a smaller Indian web hosting provider built around standard cPanel shared hosting, reseller hosting and KVM-based VPS plans. Unlike many budget hosts that lock customers into long annual terms, it advertises month-to-month billing alongside multi-year discounted terms, which is a genuine point of difference for buyers who don't want to prepay years upfront.

Shared cPanel plans start at a heavily discounted ₹49/month (Basic, 10GB NVMe SSD, 1 website) up to ₹399/month (Enterprise, 100GB NVMe SSD, 50 websites), each including a free domain, free SSL and a website builder. KVM VPS plans start at ₹299/month for 1 vCPU/4GB RAM/50GB SSD and scale to ₹1,465/month for 8 vCPU/32GB RAM/400GB SSD, running CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian or AlmaLinux. All shared and VPS plans list a 30-day money-back guarantee and a 99.9% uptime claim.

Independent coverage is thin compared to major global hosts, but a Trustpilot profile (4.4/5 from 196 reviews as of this writing) and a third-party review from WebsitePlanet both exist. WebsitePlanet's hands-on test (4.0/5) praised the low pricing, 24/7 support channels (live chat, phone, tickets, WhatsApp) and standard cPanel/Softaculous setup, but flagged slower-than-average page load times in its benchmarks and uptime that measured below the advertised guarantee during its test window — worth weighing against the low price.
policies: Host IT Smart lists a 30-day money-back guarantee on its shared cPanel and VPS hosting plans, per its own pricing pages. As with most budget hosts, promotional monthly prices apply to an initial term and renew at a higher listed rate afterward — confirm the exact renewal price and any exclusions (domain fees, add-ons) directly with Host IT Smart before purchasing, since this detail isn't independently verified beyond what's published on their site.
